"Create a lightweight, web-playable 3D Action Battle Royale game optimized for mobile-style performance, heavily inspired by Free Fire. 

1. Core Gameplay Loop @COMMENT_BODY@ Mechanics:
- Single-player vs. Bots: The player faces off against AI enemies on a contained island map.
- Drop Phase: Start the game with the player parachuting or gliding down onto the map from above.
- Looting System: Spawn specific weapons (Assault Rifle, Shotgun, Pistol), ammunition, and health medkits across the floor inside and around structures. Walking over or interacting with items adds them to the player inventory.
- Gunplay @COMMENT_BODY@ Combat: Third-person perspective (TPP) with a responsive mobile-friendly layout. Controls must include Move Joystick, Aim/Look, Shoot, Aim-Down-Sights (ADS/Scope), Crouch, Jump, and Reload.
- Shrinking Safe Zone: A radiant \"Danger Zone\" circle that shrinks over time. Players caught outside the safe zone take progressive damage over time.

2. Visual Style @COMMENT_BODY@ World Design:
- Art Style: Low-poly, vibrant 3D aesthetic ensuring smooth frame rates.
- Environment: A tropical or desert island map featuring scattered structures (houses, metal containers, walls for cover) and natural terrain obstacles (trees, grass, rocks).
- UI/HUD: Mobile-inspired overlay displaying a minimap with safe zone boundaries, an active player health bar, current weapon ammo counts, a button to trigger medkits, and a live counter of remaining alive enemies.

3. Game State @COMMENT_BODY@ Win/Loss Conditions:
- Winning: Eliminate all enemy bots to trigger a victory screen celebrating \"Booyah!\" or \"Victory!\".
- Losing: Player health drops to 0, showing a \"Game Over\" screen with a \"Restart Match\" button. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---

## Objective
- Build a lightweight, mobile-friendly, web-playable 3D battle royale inspired by Free Fire, with bots, looting, combat, a shrinking safe zone, and win/loss states.

## Requirements
- Single-player island match with drop/glide start, weapon/ammo/medkit pickups, TPP combat, bots, safe-zone damage, mobile touch controls, HUD/minimap, and victory/game-over restart.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented an original low-poly island game titled “LAST LIGHT” using Three.js from a CDN and a custom responsive HUD.
- Used lightweight procedural geometry and simplified bot AI/combat to keep performance modest.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with responsive mobile-inspired controls, HUD, minimap, overlays, and start/restart panel.
- Created `game.js` with procedural island scenery, weapons and loot, player/bot actors, zone logic, keyboard/touch input, and game states.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 and opened the game in Playwright; page loaded with title “LAST LIGHT — Island Royale.”

### Active
- Validate rendered gameplay and interactions; inspect a screenshot and address any runtime issues.

### Blocked
- Browser check reported one console error: missing `/favicon.ico` (likely nonessential); no game-specific error was identified yet.

## Next Move
1. Capture a screenshot at `http://localhost:3002` and inspect the latest image.
2. Start a match and test deployment, movement, firing, loot, zone damage, and restart.
3. Fix any issues found and summarize assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, mobile controls, overlays, and Three.js entrypoint.
- `game.js`: Game world, gameplay systems, controls, bot logic, and render loop.

## Important Context
- Local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` succeeded after installing Chromium.
- The reported console error was `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found) @ http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico:0`.
- Changes are uncommitted.

- Build a lightweight, mobile-friendly, web-playable 3D battle royale inspired by Free Fire, with bots, looting, combat, a shrinking safe zone, and win/loss states.

- Implemented an original low-poly island game titled “LAST LIGHT” using Three.js from a CDN, procedural scenery, simplified bots/combat, and a responsive HUD.

- Mouse clicks and touch fire-button presses now shoot immediately as well as continuing to fire while held.

- `game.js`: Island world, gameplay systems, controls, bot logic, and render loop.

## Objective
- Build a lightweight, mobile-friendly, web-playable 3D battle royale inspired by Free Fire, with bots, looting, combat, a shrinking safe zone, and win/loss states.

## Requirements
- Single-player island match with drop/glide start, weapon/ammo/medkit pickups, TPP combat, bots, safe-zone damage, mobile touch controls, HUD/minimap, and victory/game-over restart.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented an original low-poly island game titled “LAST LIGHT” using Three.js from a CDN, procedural scenery, simplified bots/combat, and a responsive HUD.
- Added a data-URI favicon to avoid the missing `/favicon.ico` request.
- Mouse clicks and touch fire-button presses shoot immediately and continue firing while held.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the responsive game UI and gameplay systems in `index.html` and `game.js`.

- (none)

1. Continue browser testing loot pickup, zone damage, and win/loss flows; determine why attempted movement did not reach loot.

3. Review changes and report results, including the four Chromium WebGL GPU-stall warnings (zero console errors).

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, touch controls, overlays, and Three.js entrypoint.
- `game.js`: Island world, gameplay systems, controls, bot logic, and render loop.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` lists `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` as untracked.
